root_cause: The original CMS editor exposes raw JSON and CSS selectors for ordinary editorial changes, causing unnecessary technical work and risk of editing mistakes. No accessible task-oriented authoring layer was available.
prevention: Progressive enhancement of the ORIGINAL authenticated CMS form with semantic fields, preservation of JSON keys, unsaved-change protection, original server-side content QA, same-origin draft-only preview and no new publication authority.
owner: original CMS admin + portal-state-eu publication writer; existing ONE BRAIN/Heartbeat/CRO ownership unchanged

future_acceptance: following real user editorial completion and incident recurrence checks

evidence.source: GitHub original cms.html + assets/cms-admin.js + original CMS quality gate
